newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - GM upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GM upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Bros analyst John Kirnan said in a research note that he raised his recommendation on General Motors Corp to buy from hold "given GM's exceptional performance for the (third) quarter" just reported.
-- Shares were up 1/8 to 52-1/4 in midsession NYSE trade.
-- The analyst also said he believes "the stock has the potential to broach a minimum of $65 over the next 6-12 months."
-- Kirnan raised the 1997 earnings estimate to $7.50 per share from $6.75, and the 1996 estimate remains $6.25 "pending a resolution of the CAW (Canadian Auto Workers) strike."

-- "Clearly, our official fourth quarter estimate of $1.85 per share is already too high, given that the strike has now entered its second week and is beginning to adversely impact U.S. operations," according to the analyst.
-- "At a minimum, we anticipate a significant increase in the annual dividend to at least $2.00 per share from the current $1.60 per share level once labor issues have been resolved," he said.
